questions: Did the s-bend hold 19 or more finishes with line_loss_events at or below 0.8, and did its steering_oscillation stay under about 0.35?
Did the slalom finish any trials, or did its progress rise above 0.34 with line_loss_events below 1.1?
Did the oval hold 20 of 20 with max_error at or below 0.02? If it rose, the controller change is adding lag.
If the slalom stays at its max_error floor with 0 finishes, is geometry at its limit, so the next step should be a further controller change or a track width trial (0.095)?

intent: Hold the iteration 8 best geometry unchanged (y 0.075, 12 mm footprint, wheel_track 0.09, body_length 0.10, mass 0.6) so the Integrator's controller change is the only variable in this race. Expect the s-bend to keep 19 or more finishes and the oval to stay at 20 of 20 with max_error near 0.017. Any slalom improvement should come from control, not geometry.
learning: Iteration 8 showed that y 0.075 raised the score (658 to 668) with the oval unchanged and slalom progress up from 0.26 to 0.34, but it did not lift the slalom to a finish and raised s-bend line losses to 0.80. Geometry now looks close to its limit at mass 0.6 and body_length 0.10. The next gains are more likely from control. Iteration 7 (mass 0.5) and iteration 6 (body 0.10, y 0.07) are the reference points if this race regresses.
rationale: Iteration 8 (score 667.95) is the best measured design: body_length 0.10, mass 0.6, sensors at y 0.075, 12 mm footprint, 15 mm pitch, wheel_track 0.09. Against iteration 6 it kept the oval at 20 of 20 with max_error 0.0165 and lifted the slalom progress from 0.26 to 0.34, so the extra look-ahead is not adding lag on the oval. The s-bend held 19 of 20 finishes with progress 0.993, but line losses rose from 0.55 to 0.80 and oscillation was 0.32, which is under the 0.35 limit. The slalom still has 0 finishes, max_error at the 0.065 floor and 1.1 line losses per run. Iteration 7 showed mass 0.5 reverses the s-bend gain, so the inertia lever is at its useful limit. Wider track (0.095 or 0.10) would trade s-bend turn authority for slalom retention, but at this inertia the s-bend is already at 19 finishes and the slalom has not responded to track or look-ahead within a clear margin, so I do not gain evidence for that trade in this step. I therefore hold every geometric value at the iteration 8 best and change nothing. This lets the Integrator's controller change be read on a fixed platform. Expected result: the oval and s-bend stay at or near iteration 8 levels, and any slalom gain comes from the controller. If the slalom remains at its max_error floor with 0 finishes after the controller change, the geometry has reached its limit for these tracks.
